parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. Takes effect only for diagnostic metrics that do not require Cloud Assistant commands to be run in the guest OS.

parameters.name: MetricSetId
parameters.description: The diagnostic metric set ID. If left empty, the default diagnostic metric set dms-instancedefault for ECS instances is used.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Takes effect only for diagnostic metrics that do not require Cloud Assistant commands to be run in the guest OS.
